summary: Collections change only through new versions; the highest version is shown on Galaxy and Automation Hub while older ones stay downloadable. Use semantic versioning for major, minor and patch bumps.
questions: Which version of my collection does Galaxy show by default?
When should I bump the major version of a collection?
Is adding a new module a minor or patch version bump?
Can users still install older versions of my collection?

answer_card.title: Collection versioning
answer_card.answer_md:
The only way to change a collection is a new version. The highest version is displayed on Galaxy/Automation Hub; older ones remain downloadable. Use semver:
- **Major** (`x`): incompatible API change
- **Minor** (`y`): backwards-compatible features (new modules/plugins, parameters, return values)
- **Patch** (`z`): backwards-compatible bug fixes
